title: Same event as S11 under Acme's rules
story: Identical markets and supply to S11, but Acme protects the lowest cover first: X is filled to its full 100 (reaching 15 days), then X and Y rise together, ending with Y at 100. X still runs out (15 days of cover vs a 28-day run) but it got everything it ordered, so no human is needed. Same shortage, different customer, different answer: Acme sends the cases to the market closest to running out.
